woven.End-to-End Ownership: I led the UX for Generative Drive Coach across research, HMI, voice interaction design, prototyping, and validation.
woven.Reusable Coaching Patterns: I scaled a teen driving concept into coaching patterns covering parking, intersections, stop signs, turns, lane changes, and speed management.
woven.Cross-Functional Partnership: I grounded designs in CARLA simulation, Vehicle SDK signals, and CAN bus data to test coaching against live vehicle states.
woven.Multi-Fidelity Prototyping: I built prototypes across voice-enabled Figma flows, CARLA simulator scenarios, and a physical steering and pedal rig.
woven.Independent Research & Validation: I ran study plans, voice-frequency tests, and CARLA driving simulations to validate and refine coaching behavior from participant feedback.

fleet-co-pilot.End-to-End Ownership: I designed Fleet Co-Pilot end to end, covering the cockpit HUD, the incident taxonomy, and the office review dashboard.
fleet-co-pilot.Reusable Incident Taxonomy: I built a subsystem and severity taxonomy that powered one-tap driver tags, the hazard map, and the office incident log.
fleet-co-pilot.Cross-Functional Partnership: I designed for fleet teams by pairing sub-second quick-tags for drivers with exposure analytics and audit trails for ops and compliance.
fleet-co-pilot.Multi-Fidelity Prototyping: I validated the taxonomy with simulated cockpit fixture data and built the office dashboard as a second consumer of that schema.
fleet-co-pilot.Independent Research & Validation: I surveyed fleet operators on dispatch optimization, predictive maintenance, multi-vendor AV monitoring, safety-driver incident reporting, and video tagging.

fleet-dashboard.End-to-End Ownership: I led the design for Fleet Dashboard across the incident log, the hazard map, and the team-wins panel for engineers.
fleet-dashboard.One Taxonomy, One Dashboard: I rendered the cockpit subsystem and severity classification directly in the dashboard without re-mapping data or creating a separate schema.
fleet-dashboard.Validated Palette, Not Guessed: I tested every color through a validator, paired severity hues with text labels, and checked contrast on the dark surface.
fleet-dashboard.Built From Real Fixtures: I built panels using typed damage fixtures, computed team-wins metrics from incidents, and plotted hotspots on OpenStreetMap tiles.
fleet-dashboard.Same Taxonomy, New Surface: I extended the cockpit data model to provide a live map for hotspot patterns, vehicle damage summaries, and team-wins panels.

drive-coach-ios.End-to-End Ownership: I designed and built the SwiftUI app solo, creating the data model, scoring engine, and all four navigation tabs.
drive-coach-ios.Reusable Score Language: I used one ScoreBand and ConfidenceBand vocabulary across the score ring, trend badges, skill bars, and streak banner.
drive-coach-ios.Borrowed the Shape, Not the Skin: I adapted Apple Health patterns to create a rolling Confidence Score, paired win-and-focus coaching cards, and Skill Overview bars.
drive-coach-ios.Fluid by Default: I implemented iOS 17 numeric content transitions, viewport scroll transitions, view-aligned snapping, and spring press states across cards.
drive-coach-ios.Independent Research & Validation: I drew patterns from Apple announcements, using baseline-relative trend language, celebration-and-focus card pairings, and explanatory lines under scores.

how2to.Brainstorming Sessions: I held five internal sessions to ideate onboarding flows, spatial interactions, and modular templates like stove markers and screw guides.
how2to.Competitor Analysis: I analyzed platforms like JigSpace and WikiHow VR, finding gaps in interactive guidance, spatial fidelity, and cross-context templates.
how2to.User Interviews: I interviewed nine participants who used online tutorials, finding most struggled to switch between tasks and wanted hands-free instruction.
how2to.Persona Building: I built three user personas from interview data: a DIY repairer, a home cook, and a computer builder.
how2to.Affinity Mapping: I clustered interview responses around multitasking load, switching friction, demand for spatial tutorials, and headset interest for hands-free guidance.

omniabrowser.Brainstorming Sessions: I coordinated with a full-stack team on development, backend systems, AI recommendations, and interactive Figma and code prototypes.
omniabrowser.Competitor Analysis: I reviewed media sharing applications across Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest, comparing native and third-party solutions to evaluate gaps.
omniabrowser.User Interviews: I conducted over fifteen interviews with traditional media users, spatial content creators, headset owners, and company founders on use cases.
omniabrowser.Persona Building: We developed user personas for spatial content viewers and creators to capture their motivations, constraints, expectations, and feature priorities.
omniabrowser.Affinity Mapping: We synthesized interview, competitor, and brainstorming data through affinity mapping to categorize user pain points, core needs, and prioritized features.

spatialshowroom.Brainstorming Sessions: I organized a full-stack team to address development, backend requirements, 3D model delivery, and prototyping in Figma and code.
spatialshowroom.Competitor Analysis: I evaluated web car configurators to borrow functional configuration features and translated those mechanics into a Vision Pro app.
spatialshowroom.User Interviews: I conducted over 25 interviews with traditional media users, spatial content creators, headset owners, and founders on use cases.
spatialshowroom.Persona Building: We created personas for tech-savvy buyers and shoppers who needed real-life views, using their constraints to prioritize showroom features.
spatialshowroom.Affinity Mapping: We organized insights from interviews, competitor audits, and brainstorming sessions into categorized pain points, needs, and prioritized features.

syncare-ai-health.Research & Discovery: I audited EHR platforms and interviewed seven patients and three clinicians, identifying chronic condition management, medication adherence, and preventive screening.
syncare-ai-health.Literature Review: I reviewed academic research on digital twins, personalization, and AI ethics, establishing trust and psychological safety as core design requirements.
syncare-ai-health.Stakeholder Interviews: I interviewed stakeholders to gather requirements, shaping project principles and refining prototype features to match real patient needs.
syncare-ai-health.Usability Evaluations: I tested prototypes with users, measuring clarity, emotional support, and personalization to iterate and refine the design.
syncare-ai-health.Design & Prototyping: I developed modular mobile prototypes for conversational interfaces, health timelines, risk cards, and lab result normalizers for usability testing.

sitelens.Research & Discovery: I audited inspection tools and interviewed inspectors, managers, and trade engineers, identifying role-specific checklists, visual comparisons, and cost verification.
sitelens.Literature Review: I reviewed research on construction AR and wearables, focusing on data compliance, legal notifications, and real-time collaboration requirements.
sitelens.Stakeholder Interviews: I interviewed field stakeholders to capture tool requirements and design room-based inspection checklists, tailored dashboards, and contractor workflows.
sitelens.Usability Evaluations: I tested AR prototypes with field users to measure time saved over paper workflows and improve voice commands and readability.
sitelens.Design & Prototyping: I built prototypes for mobile and Even Realities G1 glasses, testing room-wise task overlays, photo attachments, and verification prompts.
